accuracyFlags.claim: Wind section: 'some routes close to high-sided vehicles in strong wind, including the Rimutaka Hill Road and parts of the Desert Road' (lib/content/rules.ts).
accuracyFlags.correct: Use the official name Remutaka Hill (SH2, renamed 2017). NZTA closes SH2 Remutaka Hill in severe wind (recently to all traffic) and warns high-sided vehicles; for SH1 Desert Road NZTA issues strong-wind cautions only, with no wind closure to high-sided vehicles found. Suggested: 'NZTA closes SH2 Remutaka Hill in severe wind and warns high-sided vehicles on exposed routes such as the SH1 Desert Road; check NZTA Journey Planner before you travel.'

rejectedFlags: Class 1 licence: 'A campervan can be legal on a Class 1 licence' is correct (full Class 1 covers up to 6,000 kg GLW; overseas licence holders treated as Class 1 for 12 months). Omission, not error.
3,500 kg speed threshold without 'gross': correct per NZTA (heavy vehicles over 3,500 kg gross 90 km/h); imprecise, not wrong.
Child restraints for under-sevens: matches NZTA; exemptions omitted, not an error.
